Coram : DORAISWAMY RAJU*, ARIJIT PASAYAT
B Evidence Act, 1872-Section 32: Dying Declaration when not corroborated-Evidentiary value of­ He/d: When court is satisfied that dying declaration is not the result of C tutoring, prompting or product of imagination but made by deceased voluntarily and also the declarant was in fit state of convicting the accused. Dying declaration-Probability of making-Relevant factors-Held: Percentage of burns alone does not determine probability or otherwise of making dying declaration-Nature of burns, part of body affected, impact of burn on faculties to think and convey idea or facts coming
